cards.title: Approve the $180K Metrio contract to replace three analytics tools

blocks.text: Two incumbent renewals auto-execute September 30 — the decision window is now.

cards.notes: One sentence, then stop: we spend 288 on three tools, Metrio does it for 180. Payback math is on c5 if challenged.

cards.title: Analytics spend hits $288K across three overlapping tools

blocks.text: All three contracts renewed last year without a consolidation review.

cards.notes: Do not itemise features here — the point is three bills for one job.

cards.title: Six teams pay twice for the same dashboards

blocks.caption: Seats duplicated across two or more tools, by team

blocks.text: Every new hire in these teams adds two licences by default.

cards.notes: If asked why duplication happened: dashboard migration debt, not negligence. Keep it forward-looking.

cards.title: Metrio delivers 92% of current usage at 63% of the cost

blocks.label: of tracked dashboard usage covered by Metrio

items: The uncovered 8% is legacy exports two teams already plan to retire
$180K flat contract replaces $288K across three renewals
Migration runs inside Q4 with no new headcount

cards.notes: The 92% comes from usage-log analysis — offer the appendix detail if the number is challenged.

cards.title: Two alternatives fall short on SSO and data residency
cards.notes: Graphline is cheaper but fails residency outright — that is the one-line answer if price comes up.

cards.title: We need signatures before the September 30 renewal deadlines

blocks.text: Dashly and Chartio renew automatically Sept 30; cancellation needs 30 days' notice.
Signing by September 1 avoids a full year of double payment on two of the three tools. The ask: approve the Metrio contract and authorise the two cancellations.

cards.notes: Close on the single decision. If the room stalls, the fallback is cancelling Plotdeck alone — but say clearly that saves only $60K.

cards.title: Migration runs eight weeks with the existing team

items: Weeks 1–2: SSO, workspace setup, top-20 dashboards rebuilt
Weeks 3–6: team-by-team migration, old tools read-only
Weeks 7–8: legacy export retirement and cancellation notices
Rollback point: end of week 4, before read-only cutover
